verse.verse_1: By the sun and its heat and brightness,
verse.verse_2: and by the moon as it follows it;
verse.verse_3: and by the day as it displays the sun's glory,
verse.verse_4: and by the night as it envelopes the sun;
verse.verse_5: and by the sky and by Him Who made it;
verse.verse_6: and by the earth and by Him Who stretched it out;
verse.verse_7: and by the soul and by Him Who perfectly proportioned it,
verse.verse_8: and imbued it with (the consciousness of) its evil and its piety:
verse.verse_9: He who purifies it will prosper,
verse.verse_10: and he who suppresses it will be ruined.
verse.verse_11: In their presumptuous insolence the Thamud called the Truth a lie
verse.verse_12: when their arch-criminal rose up in rage.
verse.verse_13: Then Allah's Messenger warned them: “Hands off the she-camel and her drink!”
verse.verse_14: But they rejected his statement as a lie and hamstrung the she-camel. For that crime their Lord rumbled down upon them, utterly razing them to the ground.
verse.verse_15: He has no fear of its sequel.
